decision.explanation: The query asks for the genre of the film 'Inner Sanctum'. The provided sources contain conflicting claims regarding the genre of the 1948 film 'Inner Sanctum' and a separate 1991 film with the same title. Sources D1S1 and D2S2 explicitly classify the 1948 film as 'film noir'. Conversely, sources D3S1, D3S6, and D4S3 classify the 1948 film as a 'romantic comedy'. Source D5 describes a 1991 film titled 'Inner Sanctum' and identifies its genre as 'erotic thriller'. Since the question does not specify a year, and distinct valid referents (different films with the same name) coexist with complementary or contradictory assertions in the source text, all three genres found in the documents are retained as valid answers corresponding to their respective film instances.
